name: Salt Lake City
tagline: World-Class Skiing, Outdoor Paradise, and Affordable Mountain Living
description: Salt Lake City offers unrivaled access to outdoor recreation with seven world-class ski resorts within 45 minutes and five national parks within a day's drive. The city has modernized rapidly with a growing food and craft beer scene, excellent public transit including light rail, and a cost of living well below other mountain West cities like Denver or Boulder. Utah's business-friendly tax environment and strong economy provide stability, while the dramatic Wasatch Mountain backdrop makes even the daily commute scenic.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Good – lower crime rates than most comparably sized US cities
quickFacts.climate: Continental with cold, snowy winters and hot, dry summers

housing.description: Cheapest acceptable studio or small 1BR in South Salt Lake, Murray, or the West Valley edge

dining.description: Home cooking the norm; affordable ethnic spots out a couple of times a week

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan on Utah's ACA marketplace, assuming annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600; Utah's premiums are among the nation's lowest. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: TRAX light rail and bus for daily transit, plus a paid-off used car (SLC has solid transit for a Western city)

entertainment.description: Hiking the Wasatch, City Creek Canyon walks, free temple-district tours

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or small one-bedroom in Sugar House or Murray, with TRAX light rail covering much of daily transit — a rare Western-city advantage that trims the transport floor. Cooking at home is the norm and ski passes are out of reach, but hiking and trail running in the Wasatch foothills are free and minutes away. The ACA Silver premium is low here — Utah's benchmark is among the nation's cheapest — provided annual income stays under the 2026 ~$62,600 subsidy cutoff.

housing.description: A decent 1BR in a solid neighborhood — Millcreek, Sugar House edge, or near 9th & 9th

dining.description: Dining out several times a week across SLC's growing restaurant and brewery scene

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost low if MAGI is managed under the cliff

transportation.description: A reliable Subaru or similar for mountain access, insurance, plus a transit pass

entertainment.description: Ski passes at Snowbird or Brighton, a gym, national-park road trips, Jazz tickets

2M.lifestyle: A decent place in The Avenues or near 9th & 9th, eating out several times a week across SLC's rising restaurant and brewery scene, and a season ski pass at Snowbird or Brighton. A reliable car handles weekend road trips to Utah's national parks, and Jazz tickets and a gym membership round out an outdoors-built life. Comfortable, with room for hobbies and travel.

housing.description: A high-quality 1BR or small home in The Avenues, 9th & 9th, or Federal Heights

dining.description: Regular dining at top spots like HSL and Valter's Osteria; daily cafe culture

healthcare.description: A Gold-tier plan; padded near the ~$62,600 ACA subsidy cutoff

transportation.description: A late-model SUV for canyon driving, premium insurance, ski rack

entertainment.description: An Ikon pass, mountain-biking gear, Jazz season tickets, Sundance trips

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality one-bedroom or small home in The Avenues, 9th & 9th, or Federal Heights, regular dining at Salt Lake's best restaurants, an Ikon pass, and Jazz season tickets. Road trips to Moab, Zion, and Bryce all fit, along with Sundance in Park City each January. Healthcare runs through the University of Utah network and is padded near the ~$62,600 ACA subsidy cutoff. An affluent, mountain-centric life with real margin.

housing.description: A luxury condo on the East Bench or a Park City ski-adjacent unit

dining.description: Fine dining in SLC and Park City plus private-chef dinner parties

healthcare.description: An unsubsidized premium plan plus concierge medicine at University of Utah Health

transportation.description: A luxury SUV plus premium insurance and detailing

entertainment.description: Private ski-club membership, Sundance VIP passes, helicopter skiing, Jazz courtside

domesticHelp.description: Weekly cleaning, snow removal, landscaping, some assistant tasks

luxuryExtras.description: Quarterly travel, custom mountain-bike builds, Sundance Institute patronage

5M.lifestyle: A luxury East Bench home with Wasatch views or a ski-adjacent Park City condo, weekly housekeeping, and a luxury SUV. Fine dining across SLC and Park City is routine, healthcare is unsubsidized concierge care at University of Utah Health, and business class is standard for longer trips. Private ski-club access and Jazz courtside seats fit comfortably.

housing.description: A luxury foothills or Emigration Canyon home, or a premium downtown penthouse

dining.description: Private-chef dining and exclusive mountain dining experiences

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized plan plus concierge care and executive screenings

transportation.description: A premium 4WD vehicle with full ownership costs, plus regular private car service

entertainment.description: A private ski lodge, Sundance trustee-level access, international adventure travel

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeping several days a week plus grounds and snow-removal service

luxuryExtras.description: Heli-skiing packages, first-class international travel, ranch property

10M.lifestyle: A luxury foothills or Emigration Canyon home, or a premium downtown penthouse, with household help several days a week and occasional private-chef evenings alongside the city's best tables, plus top-tier concierge medicine. Travel is first class and any resort in Utah is skiable without a second thought. Salt Lake's moderate cost base means roughly $206k a year covers premium living with healthy margins.
